name: sb-*-auth-token
duration: Provider-managed session; until sign-out or session expiry; verify configuration

name: inv-watch, inv-lists
purpose: Requested asset/country watchlists and dashboard lists
duration: Until cleared or removed; account copies follow account retention

name: inv-follow, inv-follow-topics
purpose: Requested globe country follows and topics

name: inv-auth-seen, inv-pop, inv-guest, inv-had-account
purpose: Remember account/guest choice and dismissed prompts
type: Strictly necessary to respect those choices

name: inv-news-optin, inv-sub
type: Strictly necessary to record requested choice
duration: No coded expiry; inv-news-optin resets after account update

name: inv-wb (sessionStorage)
purpose: Welcome-back prompt once per browser session

name: inv-theme, inv-pal, inv-studio
purpose: Theme, chart palette and studio appearance
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-profile, inv-notif-read
purpose: Legacy local display profile and notification-read count
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-learn
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-* (Cache Storage, not a cookie)
purpose: Versioned first-party offline app files and saved responses
type: Strictly necessary for requested offline app
duration: Older versions removed on service-worker activation; browser may evict

name: Usage events (no separate analytics storage key)
purpose: Optional page/interaction statistics sent to Supabase
